Social Security and veterans' benefits should be completely tax-free. These aren't handouts — they're earned. That's why I introduced the Social Security Check Tax Cut Act and the Tax Cuts for Veterans Act.

These bills take the first steps in boosting the income of millions of seniors and veterans in Nebraska and across the country.

As Nebraskans file their taxes, they can expect to see more money back in their pockets thanks to the Working Families Tax Cuts. The Working Families Tax Cuts removes taxes on tips, up to $25,000 per year. The tax cuts also eliminate taxes on overtime pay, up to $12,500.

These savings will bring meaningful relief for hard-working servers, bartenders, and workers who depend on gratuities at that establishment and countless others across the state.

Great to be on the Missouri River with Assistant Secretary Adam Telle of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers touring flood mitigation projects here in Nebraska.

Video

Today marks the 47th anniversary of the Taiwan Relations Act, the foundation of the growing U.S.-Taiwan defense, tech, and trade partnership. I am proud to stand with Taiwan as they face Communist China’s continued illegal, coercive, and deceptive actions. The U.S. remains committed to Taiwan and the defense of democracy.

The Working Families Tax Cuts delivers for Nebraska. No tax on tips. No tax on overtime. A permanent Death Tax exemption so Nebraska farming and ranching families can pass their business to the next generation.

This tax season, I’m protecting the Good Life.

It's officially tax season. I've got good news: Nebraskans are likely to see more money in their pockets this year.

The Working Families Tax Cuts prevented a $2,443 tax increase on the average Nebraska family.

CBS reports that average tax refund will increase $1,000.

Nebraskans work hard. They deserve it.

Great to tour the new Kimball Health Services facility this week. It’s a beautiful facility, with state-of-the-art tools to keep Nebraskans healthy.

We discussed the Rural Health Transformation program, which was included in the Working Families Tax Cuts. This program provides $218 million to the State of Nebraska to create investments in rural healthcare. We need to support healthcare facilities like Kimball Health Services so our rural communities can thrive for years to come.

Great to stop by Blair’s Memorial Community Hospital. 

It was great to get an update on their facility and hear how I can continue to support them in the Senate. We also discussed the implementation of the funds from the Rural Health Transformation Program.
Grateful for the bravery of our service members who went behind enemy lines to save one of our own.
Happy Easter, Nebraska! He is risen!

Congratulations Coach!

AP named Fred Hoiberg Coach of the Year for his leadership of Nebraska men’s basketball through a historic season.

Much deserved. GO BIG RED!


Nebraska Men's Basketball (@HuskerMBB)

The nation's best resides in Lincoln.

Coach Hoiberg is your Associated Press National Coach of the Year.





— https://nitter.net/HuskerMBB/status/2040112651225686127#m
Today reminds us that even in the darkest moments, Jesus Christ's love for us is always a beacon of light. Wishing everyone a blessed Good Friday.

The Trump administration and @epaleezeldin are committed to supporting Nebraska biofuels. They announced the largest RVOs in history!
 
Biofuels are a win for consumers, the environment, and farmers and ranchers. The latest RVOs unleash American energy and support Nebraska agriculture.
 
I’ll keep fighting for a five-year Farm Bill and permanent, year-round E15.

Great to be in Blair this week touring Novonesis and Evonik!

We partnered with @ShopFloorNAM and discussed how the Working Families Tax Cuts boosts the manufacturing industry. The no tax on overtime provisions specifically are helping these manufacturers keep workers!
Wishing a peaceful and happy Passover to all who are celebrating. Chag Pesach Sameach!

America is preparing to cheer on Artemis II, the first crewed lunar flyby in over 50 years. General Dynamics in Lincoln manufactured several components integral to the mission’s success, including the oxygen tanks onboard the rocket.

Nebraska is keeping our astronauts alive as they head towards the moon!

Great to be at the White House last week to celebrate the heart and soul of Nebraska—our farmers and ranchers. Our farmers don’t just grow food—they grow the raw materials for America’s future. Thank you to @POTUS for opening new markets for American agriculture.

Video

Nebraskans deserve elected officials who will put their communities’ interests ahead of their own personal interest. That’s why I introduced the Stop Insider Trading Act in the Senate. @RepBryanSteil is leading on it in the House. 

Our bill eliminates even the appearance of impropriety by prohibiting Members of Congress, their spouses, and dependent children from buying new stock.
